title: EFF to Courts: Don't Rewrite Copyright over AI Hype
summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) is urging courts to resist pressure from tech companies seeking to rewrite copyright law during the current AI hype cycle. EFF argues that existing copyright frameworks should not be abandoned simply because AI companies claim they need broader rights to train their models and generate content.
problem_solved: Addresses the legal uncertainty around whether AI training on copyrighted material and AI-generated content should be protected under current copyright law or require new exemptions.
why_valuable: This advocacy helps maintain the balance between protecting creators' rights and allowing technological innovation, preventing companies from using market pressure to circumvent established legal protections.
